description: Booklet page 2 (#281). The red "REMEMBER" over a tinted box is a callout label, never the document's title or a heading. Page 1's title is lost to OCR (the page-1 spec), and no metadata or bookmark names the document, so the title is the file name, sent to review. The REMEMBER callout is painted on a tinted rectangle: one filled group, an aside, named by its first line, holding the label and the sentence (#281).
